rec:1d daily
rec:2w weekly
rec:3m monthly
rec:1y yearly
rec:+1d explicit plus is accepted
rec:0d zero is out of range
rec:10000d above the maximum
rec:abc not a recurrence value
rec:1D uppercase unit is rejected
rec:1d rec:2w duplicate rec becomes an array
due:2026-11-01 rec:2d the due date does not move the next due date
due:2026-12-31 rec:1m the month copy uses the completion time
x 2024-01-01 2023-12-31 rec:1w done recurring line
